title: Handy Little Appliance to Have In The Kitchen
text:
Handy Little Appliance to Have In The Kitchen. The Tiger 5 1/2 cup rice cooker has performed flawlessly on everything we've tried. Not only did it produce excellent results on various kinds of rice (white rice, brown rice, multigrain rice, wild rice) but it's also been good for cooking porridge (steel cut oats in our case) and even hard-boiled eggs). Nothing we've used it for has turned out less than perfect.

This cooker even has a synchro-cooking mode which allows you to cook concurrently using the included cook plate. I have not used this mode yet but have already picked out several fairly simple recipes which I plan to attempt in the near future.

Since cooking with a rice cooker is a new experience for me, I appreciated the Tiger operating instructions included with the unit. It is very thorough and contains helpful sections including basic how-to information and troubleshooting. Also included with this rice cooker is a cookbook which includes 25 recipes, many of which are for synchro-cooking. To help you explore the world of rice cooker cooking, I strongly recommend purchasing a basic rice cooker cookbook to accompany the included material. This will assist in unlocking the full potential of your rice cooker, a consistent and dependable option in preparing one-pot meals, side dishes, etc. You will find that the Tiger rice cooker is a surprisingly versatile addition to the kitchen, especially considering how little counter space it requires. It is easy to use and clean-up is easy, too.

If you have the time and patience, you could prepare many of the same things on your stove top that this rice cooker does, thereby saving the cost of purchasing one. The question to consider is whether the Tiger 5 1/2 cup rice cooker is worth its price in order to have the convenience of being able to set it to cook perfect rice while you do other things. That convenience is worth a lot to me, and I'm guessing to many other people as well.

features: 10-Cup Micom Rice Cooker & Warmer with Tiger's exclusive "tacook" cooking plate for synchronize cooking
10 cooking settings: Plain, Synchro-Cooking, Quick (for faster cooking cycle), Sweet, Mixed, Porridge, Multigrain, Brown Rice, Slow Cook, and Steam
Spherical inner pot (1.8-mm) with non-stick coating
Easy to remove and wash inner lid and steam cap
2 preset cooking timers (up to 24 hours) and automatic "Keep Warm" after cooking completion (up to 12 hours)
description: Tiger's Micom Rice Cooker & Warmer, Steamer, and Slow Cooker allows you to cook more than rice. It comes with Tiger's unique "tacook" cooking plate, which allows you to synchronize rice cooking and main dish to cook two dishes at the same time. With minimal preparation and the press of a button, Automatic Cooking Logic actively monitors cooking temperatures to create the perfect meal. With automatic "Keep Warm" mode and the two preset delay timers (up to 24 hours), you can prepare easy and healthy dish to your needs.
